boundary.rule: a point estimate or interval bound of exactly 0 or 1 is unresolved and is not written
boundary.why: E_KLF12_HIGH has logic = E_KLF12_HIGH, so an initial probability of 0 or 1 fixes it in every trajectory: a clamp in effect, which scRNA zeros and dropout may never create

bridge_assumption.status: interpretive assumption with no experimental support in this repository; every conditioned result must carry it
bridge_assumption.text: the ensemble frequency with which the modelled epithelial compartment is initialised in the KLF12-high state equals the estimated fraction of epithelial cells in that state.

claim_rule: every generated value carries the bridge assumption and claim_level=assumption_conditioned_scenario; it may not be described as measured personalization unless RR13 is met and the owner has accepted it before the claim is upgraded
clipping: none: no value is moved into range; an out-of-range or boundary value is refused (config/personalization.yaml clipping [0, 1] is not used)

high_state_definition.never_from: the ADOC donors, their per-unit statistics, or any outcome

per_cell_quantity_definitions.count: the feature's value in the deposited counts layer (node_support per-cell column counts_<gene>)
per_cell_quantity_definitions.count_per_10k: count / depth_counts * 10^4, where depth_counts is the cell's column sum of the deposited counts layer (node_support per-cell column depth_counts)

high_state_definition.supplied_by: the external reference only (RR01-RR12 and RR14)

missing.default_0_5: never applied implicitly; only as an explicitly declared model assumption with its own provenance, which this contract does not declare
missing.rule: a missing, empty, below-minimum or condition-unresolved unit yields initial_on_probability=unresolved and keeps the shared baseline istate
missing.zero_detection: a measured zero count is a cell not classified high by the external rule; it is never OFF for the node and never a clamp

outcome_independence: no adhesion, pregnancy, secretion, model output or phenotype value is an input to any parameter or to the high-state definition

sensitivity.claim: sensitivity variants widen the scenario set; they never satisfy RR13 or upgrade the claim
sensitivity.rule: the primary threshold and every pre-registered variant (RR14, at least two) each yield their own scenario value, reported side by side
sensitivity.selection: none: no variant is preferred, and none may be selected using ADOC outcomes or model output

source: docs/scrna/klf12_prior_preregistration.md, three steps that must not be collapsed

steps.1_measurement: the node's feature per cell, on the deposited decontX-corrected counts layer, for every cell of one donor x condition x epithelium unit
steps.2_latent_state: each cell is classified high or not by the EXTERNAL reference's per-cell high-state definition (feature, per-cell quantity, rule, threshold); the unit's estimate is the fraction of its cells classified high
steps.3_conditioning: initial_on_probability = that fraction, under the bridge assumption

uncertainty.interval: within-donor cell bootstrap of the fraction (node-support B and seed)
uncertainty.meaning: cell-sampling uncertainty of this donor's unit only; not donor or population inference, never pooled across donors
uncertainty.shared_baseline: the unpersonalized v0.5.1 baseline.cfg istate, the matched comparator for any personalized run
